verdict.rationale: Working Copy stores all repository data as standard Git repositories (open format) and provides multiple export paths: Files app/document-picker access, drag-and-drop, a built-in WebDAV server, and Shortcuts automation, meaning a user can pull all data out in a non-proprietary format at any time (docs-24, docs-25, docs-27, docs-28). This directly satisfies 'export in open formats and leave' since Git itself is portable across any host.  Missing for 10: no explicit single bulk-export/account-deletion feature described, and no independent hands-on account of a full data migration out of the app.
